name: data.gov
tagline: US federal open data catalog API for discovering and accessing government datasets
description: data.gov is the United States government's open data catalog, providing a CKAN-based API to search, discover, and retrieve metadata for federal datasets across agencies. Developers can query packages, organizations, and resources programmatically without authentication for most catalog operations.

auth.details: Most catalog endpoints require no authentication. Some write or agency-specific operations may require API keys; public read access is unauthenticated.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no published request quota for catalog API

use_cases: search federal open datasets by keyword
list datasets from a specific US agency
get metadata for a government dataset package
find downloadable resource URLs for open data files
discover climate or census datasets across agencies
